commit.subject: feat(steme): align concept keys; add guides parsing and unit discovery, unwired
commit.body:
Rename web.uiPrimitives to web.designSystemComponents and add
web.businessPresentationComponents and web.viewModels to the canonical
concept keys; teach matchGlob within-segment stars so file-shape concept
globs like modules/**/*view-model.ts can bind. Stackpack manifests gain an
optional strict guides field (root/scopes/concepts, canonical keys);
resolvePolicy now exposes the policy stackpack alongside the rulepack
refs; the audit preflight's rulepack-loading loop moves to a shared
loadActiveRulepacks used verbatim; findUnitRoot walks up from a (possibly
nonexistent) path to the nearest steme.package.json bounded by the
workspace root. No CLI change; audit behavior byte-identical with every
suite green unmodified except the mechanical key-rename and return-shape
updates.

phases.title: Concept vocabulary, guides parsing, unit discovery — unwired

commit.subject: feat(steme): add steme doctrine --for returning the workspace doctrine index
commit.body:
New read-only command: steme doctrine --for <path> [--json] resolves the
governing workspace from the path (never cwd), the unit by the same walk,
and the path's scope and concepts from the unit manifest's declared globs
alone — nonexistent paths resolve identically and file contents are never
read. The index lists the policy stackpack's root/scope/concept guide
references (workspace-anchored paths; every declared guide must exist or
the query refuses at exit 2) and the rules whose fromScope contains the
path, with their skills. A bare-rulepack policy yields a rules-only
index; exits are 0/2, never 1. Proven red-first by doctrine.e2e with the
audit/policy/baseline suites unmodified as the invariance proof;
steme.usage.kdl and docs/cli.md regenerated under their drift gates.

phases.title: The doctrine command: index, renders, e2e
